resources.string: Naari Kavach: %1$s\'s phone is switching off. Last known location: %2$s
Naari Kavach: %1$s\'s phone battery is at %2$d%%. Last known location: %3$s
Naari Kavach: The SIM card in %1$s\'s phone was changed. This message is from the new SIM. Location: %2$s

To start an SOS by pressing volume-down 5 times, even with the screen off, turn on %1$s in Accessibility settings.\n\nOn the next screen open \"Installed apps\" (or \"Downloaded apps\"), choose %1$s and switch it on. It only watches the volume keys and never reads your screen.
Pair a small Bluetooth button and press it twice to start an SOS without taking out your phone.
Looking for the button… keep it close
This device isn\'t a supported button
Turn on protection so the button can start an SOS.
%1$s will no longer start an SOS.
Press the button twice to test
Waiting for the button to connect…
Two quick presses within a second. A single press does nothing, so it can\'t go off by accident.
One press. Now press again quickly
While protection is on, a double-press starts the SOS countdown. You can still cancel during the countdown. Testing here never sends an SOS.
Switch the button on (press and hold until it beeps) and keep it next to your phone.
No buttons found. Make sure it\'s switched on and close by, then scan again.
No buttons found. Android needs Location turned on to scan for Bluetooth devices. Turn it on and scan again.
Scanning failed (error %1$d). Turn Bluetooth off and on, then try again.
This phone doesn\'t support Bluetooth Low Energy.
Turn on Bluetooth to find your button.
Naari Kavach needs the Nearby devices and Location permissions to find your button.
%1$s saved. Now press it twice to test.
%1$s, signal %2$d of 4. Double-tap to use this button.
Small Bluetooth keyfinder buttons sold as \"iTag\" or \"anti-lost tracker\" work best. They cost about ₹200 online.
A CR2032 battery lasts for months. Clip the button to your keys, bag strap or clothes.
While protection is on, your phone stays connected and reconnects on its own when the button comes back in range.
